fact: At the launch on 17 October 2023 of a four-day digital health maturity assessment run by the Ministry of Health with the Commonwealth Secretariat and WHO, the health minister said the ministry is investing in an Electronic Health Information System encompassing Electronic Medical Records, to be accessible to all health professionals throughout the system, and is working with the Department of Information Communication and Technology on its security.
title: Digital maturity of Seychelles’ health sector in the spotlight
